style_image: Flat vector cartoon, satirical corporate comic strip, bold clean outlines, muted office palette. Use the attached reference images for the EXACT character designs: the BOSS is bald with two tall pointy black hair tufts, navy suit, red tie, overconfident grin; the ENGINEER has round black glasses, white shirt, thin black tie, deadpan face. Vertical 9:16, both characters visible, medium shot. No text anywhere except where specified.
style_video: Flat 2D cartoon office comedy, keep the exact art style of the input image. Simple cartoon mouth-flap lip-sync, small natural gestures, characters stay in place. Static camera with a very slow push-in. No on-screen text, no subtitles.
voices: The bald boss with two spiky hair tufts speaks in a smug, booming corporate baritone, overflowing with unearned confidence. The engineer with round glasses speaks in a flat, tired, deadpan monotone.

scenes.name: s1_dinosaurs
scenes.keyframe: Medium shot. The BOSS (bald, two spiky hair tufts, navy suit, red tie) stands looking smug and proud, hands on his hips. The ENGINEER (round black glasses, white shirt, thin black tie) sits at a desk, looking flat and tired. SAME blue-gray glass-walled office (glass panels, blue code monitor, potted plant). The background office must contain NO other people. ABSOLUTELY NO text anywhere.
scenes.end_keyframe: BOTH MOUTHS FULLY CLOSED. Same office, same lighting, same camera framing as the start frame. The Boss retains his smug posture, while the Engineer continues his deadpan stare.
scenes.action: The boss gestures proudly: "Our new AI recruiter is brilliant. It just filtered out a thousand expensive dinosaurs." The engineer replies flatly: "You set it to auto-reject graduation dates before 2005." Each character's mouth moves ONLY while that character is speaking.
lines: Our new AI recruiter is brilliant. It just filtered out a thousand expensive dinosaurs.
You set it to auto-reject graduation dates before 2005.

scenes.name: s2_lawsuit
scenes.keyframe: Medium close-up shot. The ENGINEER (round black glasses, white shirt, thin black tie) stares deadpan at the boss. The BOSS (bald, two spiky hair tufts, navy suit, red tie) looks arrogant, chin raised. SAME blue-gray glass-walled office (glass panels, blue code monitor, potted plant). The background office must contain NO other people. ABSOLUTELY NO text anywhere.
scenes.end_keyframe: BOTH MOUTHS FULLY CLOSED. Same office, same lighting, same camera framing as the start frame. The Engineer looks thoroughly unimpressed, the Boss looks defiantly confident.
scenes.action: The engineer stares deadpan: "That's textbook age discrimination. A court ruled the algorithm is our legal agent." The boss waves a hand dismissively: "Nonsense. An algorithm can't be biased. It only measures culture fit." Each character's mouth moves ONLY while that character is speaking.
lines: That's textbook age discrimination. A court ruled the algorithm is our legal agent.
Nonsense. An algorithm can't be biased. It only measures culture fit.

scenes.name: s3_natives
scenes.keyframe: Medium two-shot. The ENGINEER (round black glasses, white shirt, thin black tie) leans slightly back, looking exhausted. The BOSS (bald, two spiky hair tufts, navy suit, red tie) is highly animated, pointing a finger upward triumphantly. SAME blue-gray glass-walled office (glass panels, blue code monitor, potted plant). The background office must contain NO other people. ABSOLUTELY NO text anywhere.
scenes.end_keyframe: BOTH MOUTHS FULLY CLOSED. Same office, same lighting, same camera framing as the start frame. The Boss is frozen in his triumphant pointing pose, the Engineer remains motionless.
scenes.action: The engineer blinks slowly: "It rejected fifty senior developers at three in the morning." The boss points upward triumphantly: "Overqualified! We need cheap, clueless digital natives who don't ask questions." Each character's mouth moves ONLY while that character is speaking.
lines: It rejected fifty senior developers at three in the morning.
Overqualified! We need cheap, clueless digital natives who don't ask questions.

scenes.name: s4_training
scenes.keyframe: Medium wide shot. The ENGINEER (round black glasses, white shirt, thin black tie) is rubbing the back of his neck in frustration. The BOSS (bald, two spiky hair tufts, navy suit, red tie) has a fist proudly pressed to his own chest, beaming. SAME blue-gray glass-walled office (glass panels, blue code monitor, potted plant). The background office must contain NO other people. ABSOLUTELY NO text anywhere.
scenes.end_keyframe: BOTH MOUTHS FULLY CLOSED. Same office, same lighting, same camera framing as the start frame. The Boss holds his proud stance, the Engineer lowers his hand wearily.
scenes.action: The engineer sighs, rubbing his neck: "Those fifty developers are now filing a massive class-action lawsuit." The boss pounds his chest proudly: "Let them try! I trained the AI perfectly on my own flawless decisions." Each character's mouth moves ONLY while that character is speaking.
lines: Those fifty developers are now filing a massive class-action lawsuit.

scenes.name: s5_terminated
scenes.keyframe: Medium two-shot. Exactly TWO people: the ENGINEER has SHORT DARK HAIR (he is NOT bald, no hair tufts) and sits at his desk; only the BOSS is bald with two spiky hair tufts. No duplicate of the boss anywhere. The ENGINEER (round black glasses, white shirt, thin black tie) has a completely flat, emotionless expression. The BOSS (bald, two spiky hair tufts, navy suit, red tie) stands across from him, looking vaguely confused. SAME blue-gray glass-walled office (glass panels, blue code monitor, potted plant). The background office must contain NO other people. ABSOLUTELY NO text anywhere.
scenes.end_keyframe: BOTH MOUTHS FULLY CLOSED. Same office, same lighting, same camera framing as the start frame. The Boss's eyes are wide with dawning horror, the Engineer's face remains totally blank.
scenes.action: The engineer adjusts his glasses: "Well, since it thinks exactly like you, it just auto-terminated our oldest employee." The boss looks suddenly confused: "Who?" The engineer deadpans: "You." Each character's mouth moves ONLY while that character is speaking.
lines: Well, since it thinks exactly like you, it just auto-terminated our oldest employee.
